notes.title: Chat Champions update -- v1.1
notes.content:
The first post-launch update is here! First off, thank you to all of the streamers who have given the game a chance thus far. That means a lot to me! I can't wait to continue implementing some of the fun additions I have in mind.

The main focus of this patch is shoring up some issues/bugs which became apparent as the game got into more people's hands. But there's some goodies packed in here, too! Read on.

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] added an option to display chat commands on the side of the screen
[*] added options to move in-game messages to top left and top right screen positions
[*] spruced up the Battle Mod sidebar pop-ups
[/list]

[h1]Leaderboards[/h1]
[list]
[*] added a Daily Leaderboard, which tracks local stats for your channel and resets at midnight UTC
[*] spruced up some visual elements
[/list]

[h1]Cosmetics[/h1]
[list]
[*] added 3 new skins for each weapon [i](bringing us up to 10 unique skins for each weapon!)[/i]
[*] added 10 new hats
[*] added 2 new player skins
[/list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]
[list]
[*] players can now earn Double, Triple, Quadra, Penta, and Ultra kill streaks for getting consecutive kills  in rapid succession, each providing a gold reward [i](Notifications for these can be toggled in the Settings menu.)[/i]
[*] changed how scoreboard points are calculated, which affects end-game standings and gold rewards
[*] teams now spawn on opposite sides of the map in Teamfight mode [i](as opposed to all jumbled up)[/i]
[*] added Headhunter upgrade [i](deal 50% more damage to your !target)[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Chat Commands[/h1]
[list]
[*] added !whois [name] command which returns a player's leaderboard information
[*] added !whatis [item] and !price [item], which both return an item's proper name and gold value
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] added rare Treasure Chests which can be opened during battle by typing !unlock -- but you'll be vulnerable while doing so!
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] fixed an issue with some input fields where using the Shift or Caps Lock key might cause 'ghost' inputs to be registered, causing the input to not be read properly
[*] fixed an issue where menu settings toggles would revert
[*] fixed an issue where deleting a single and lone custom chat command would not save
[*] fixed a UI issue where a menu navigation button and menu item could be selected at the same time, leading to errant selections when the left mouse button was pressed
[*] fixed an issue where in Slay the Streamer mode, the MVP would be set to 0
[*] fixed a queue-related crash
[*] fixed Twitch user subscription recognition
[*] fixed an issue where a couple upgrade settings were not saving/loading correctly
[*] fixed an issue where resetting some options to their default would not save/allow the player to save
[*] stopped the join timer from advancing while the game was paused
[*] fixed an issue where players could join a battle even though it was full
[*] fixed an issue where bots would auto populate a battle even though it was full
[*] fixed an issue where more bots would spawn than the maximum number of players allowed
[/list]

notes.title: Chat Champions 1.0 release!
notes.content:
Chat Champions 1.0 is finally here! Thank you to everyone who helped make this game possible, from critically important testers to the other talented artists and programmers who pitched in along the way. For myself, this was a nearly 3-year journey I wasn't always sure would see the light of day, but I'm happy to say that I stuck with it, and am extremely proud of 1.0. 

I'd also like to thank my wife for encouraging me along the way when, at times, my morale was low. If you decided to purchase the game, whether as a streamer or viewer, thank you so much for checking it out and I really hope your community enjoys their time with it. I created Chat Champions because I love the livestreaming community and wanted to connect streamers to their audiences in a fun, easy way.

This isn't the end of Chat Champions, though! I have big plans for additional content and features -- if you're interested in those, you can read more at the bottom of this post. For now -- patch notes!

[h1]1.0 changes/additions:[/h1]

[h3]UI/Options[/h3]
[list]
[*] added a Display Twitch Avatars toggle to the Display settings
[*] improved text input fields
[*] added in-game emote size + duration options to the Display settings
[*] added support for Custom Chat Commands in Twitch settings
[*] added quick battle option in Battle settings menu [i](you can also hold CTRL+Q as the game boots up)[/i]
[*] in-game emotes are now displayed in post-round chat bubbles [i](on, for example, the MVP post-round card)[/i]
[*] added an Automatic Upgrade Selection feature in the Settings menu which randomly selects an upgrade for players who did not vote for one
[/list]

[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] new game mode added -- Desktop Idle

[i]Desktop Idle is a special mode which alters aspects of the game in order to serve as a drop in/out interactive element for your stream. The battle sits at the bottom of your screen, and, coupled with Chromakey Mode, Chat Champions is now the perfect companion for moments where you'd like to feature it as an appetizer, not the main course. Players may !join as usual, but are removed after a chat inactivity period of 1 hour. This pared-down experience still grants players XP as well as gold for participating, but does not feature Battle Mods or Upgrades.[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] added an HP scaling toggle to the Settings menu
[*] added !roll X command, which will return a random number between 1-X
[*] added a number of background music tracks + other sounds
[*] changed Battle Mod voting method from 1 and 2 to A and B (to avoid AutoMod identical message detection)
[/list]

[h1]What's coming in the future?[/h1]

In a future content patch, you can expect:

[list]
[*] additional Viewer Mode benefits (special chat commands, emotes, and... pets?!)
[*] new game modes
[*] new level sets
[*] new Upgrades and Battle Mods
[*] automatic Twitch channel point prediction support
[*] more custom chat command effects
[*] new post-round content
[*] new mini-games
[*] further customization support for game modes
[*] more character + weapon skins and, of course, hats!
[/list]

notes.title: Chat Champions closed beta update -- b3.5
notes.content:
3.5 has a ton packed in! All-new Battle Mods, Upgrade additions and toggles, bug fixes, UI and game option additions, along with delicious, nutritious fruit!

This is also the debut of the web-based [url=https://www.chat-champions.com/channel_leaderboards.php]channel leaderboard[/url] and [url=https://www.chat-champions.com/weaponstats.php]global weapon stats page[/url]! Of course, this information is also available in-game within the Leaderboards, but hopefully these web-based statistics add a bit more usability and accessibility.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] fixed Steam Cloud Saves being broken
[*] fixed an oversight where Martyrdom created a large explosion instead of a small one as intended
[*] fixed an issue where emotes weren't aligned properly when in-game messages were set to appear on the righthand side
[*] stopped gravity from dealing damage to players before the round began
[*] fixed a bug where Twitch chat was incorrectly notifying players they had made the correct bet in the Scorched Wings mini-game
[*] fixed a bug where the global Channel Leaderboards post-round module would display undefined values
[*] fixed an issue where the Devilish Pact upgrade would reduce players' max health totals more than once
[*] fixed a Splinterlust upgrade crash issue
[*] re-adjusted the way points are calculated in Slay the Streamer mode to work as intended
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] added ability to click a statistic entry to shout it out in chat
[*] added Most Level-Ups section to global channel leaderboards
[*] changed how Upgrades were spaced to dynamically account for different resolutions/screen sizes
[*] added some more unique Upgrade icons
[*] added Upgrade toggles to the battle mode edit menu
[*] added Generation Settings to the battle mode edit menu

[i]Generation settings allow you to control the density of creature, crate, fruit, and mine spawns.[/i]

[*] added option to reset your stats/player data from the Settings menu
[/list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]
[list]
[*] added Fruit

[i]Fruit spawns randomly (or is placed in Arena) and heals players fully when picked up. It can also periodically be found in marked crates.[/i]

[*] changed how max health is calculated (base health+[base health*(lvl*.01)]) so it scales with base health settings
[*] Sword attack cooldown increased (25 -> 30)

[i]The Sword is slightly overperforming compared to other weapons, so this change is intended to lower its damage output over time without drastically affecting its identity or utility.[/i]

[*] added Respawns

[i]As an option, Respawns have been added to the game. You can toggle Respawns as well as tweak the number of lives and respawn delay timer from the battle mode edit menu.[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Upgrades[/h1]
[list]
[*] added Parting Gift [i](drop fruit when you die)[/i]
[*] added Fruit Dealer [i](+50 Gold when someone eats fruit)[/i]
[*] added Sugar Rush [i](gain a temporary speed boost after eating fruit)[/i]
[*] added Gravity Grove [i](fruit gravitates towards you)[/i]
[*] added Juiced [i](+X% damage after eating fruit)[/i]
[*] added Wither Aura [i](fruit rots in your vicinity)[/i]

[i]Rotten fruit deals 15 damage to players who eat it.[/i]

[*] added Vitamimpact [i](guaranteed crit after eating fruit)[/i]
[*] added Fatal Flow [i](guaranteed crit after earning a kill)[/i]
[*] added Collateral Damage [i](guaranteed crit after destroying a crate)[/i]
[*] added Primal Precision [i](guaranteed crit after killing an animal)[/i]
[*] added Scorchstrike [i](+X% crit chance while on fire)[/i]
[*] Venomous Blood max damage % reduced (8% -> 6%)
[*] made Martyrdom an Epic rarity Upgrade (was previously Rare)

[i]For how impactful it is, Martyrdom was showing up too frequently. The change to Epic rarity will ensure it isn't as present.[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Maps[/h1]
[list]
[h2]Arena[/h2]
[*] added 5 new layouts and made some changes to existing ones

[h2]Caverns[/h2]
[*] added seesaw objects
[/list]

[h1]Battle Mods[/h1]
[list]
[*] added Harvest [i](Players drop fruit when killed)[/i]
[*] added Rotten Core [i](Fruit explodes when picked up)[/i]
[*] added Fruit Frenzy [i](Spawn fruit everywhere)[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] added some more sound effects and the announcer
[/list]

notes.title: Chat Champions closed beta update -- b3.4
notes.content:
Global stat tracking has been added to the game! This will not only allow users to see statistics across every Twitch channel playing the game, but will also be used to track player information so your character could be saved across every channel.

Beta testers, your save files and statistics have been reset once again!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] fixed an issue with custom chat commands
[*] fixed an issue with custom emotes
[*] fixed an issue where the streamer might not spawn in Slay the Streamer mode
[*] fixed an issue where two results would be created if two players were still alive at the end of an FFA
[*] fixed an issue where Crossbows would not crit
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] added a right-click Paste feature to the login screen
[*] added global statistic leaderboard post-round modules
[*] added global and channel sections to the main menu Leaderboards
[*] added statistics section to the main menu Leaderboards
[*] added Armory post-round module (pay Gold and spawn with the selected weapon/upgrade)
[/list]

[i]Currently, the Armory only features standard weapons, but I plan on expanding this module in the future to include some fun upgrades and bonuses.[/i]

[h1]Mini-Games[/h1]
[list]
[*] have been added! 

[i]Mini-games randomly show up at the end of battles in place of the Gold Shop. These games involve gold wagers that any player can take part in. Currently there are two mini-games (Scorched Wings and Hop Circuit) with more coming in the future.[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sword critical hit base damage reduced (40 -> 30)
[*] Sword critical hit chance reduced (5% -> 3%)
[*] Sword base damage reduced (20 -> 18)
[*] Sword swing power reduced (70 -> 65)

[*] Staff base damage reduced (6 -> 5)

[*] Crossbow critical hit base damage increased (35 -> 50)
[*] Crossbow critical hit extra damage roll increased (7 -> 15)
[*] Crossbow critical hit chance increased (3% -> 10%)

[*] Dagger critical hit chance reduced (8% -> 5%)

[*] Spear attack range increased (40px -> 45px)
[*] Spear attack cooldown increased (30f -> 35f)
[*] Spear swing power increased (70 -> 80)
[/list]

[i]After taking a look at some statistics, it was clear that the Sword was overperforming in almost every category, and so these nerfs are an attempt to bring it back in line with the other weapons. The Sword is meant to be a jack of all trades, not THEE jack of all trades.[i]

[i]The Crossbow, while finally finding its place, seemed to need a bit more oomf when it came to killing power. Adding juicy crit damage adds a big "WOAH" moment when a critical dart connects, and gives the Crossbow more reward for deadly precision and a little luck. Because of its slower attack rate, a higher crit chance feels better for this weapon.[/i]

[i]Speaking of attack rate, the Dagger, while designed to be a critical hit lotto, is dealing way too many crits. This is due to its generally higher critical hit chance rate, but namely because of its high attack rate. To compensate for this, its critical hit chance has been reduced.[/i]

[i]Finally, the spear was given some minor changes to further solidify its identity as a long-range melee weapon with a powerful charge forward on attack.[/i]

[i]All of these balance changes have been informed by the new addition of global stat tracking.[/i]

notes.title: Chat Champions closed beta update -- b3.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Excited to drop another update as we march closer to release! Happy to say that 3.3 has a bit of everything! A few major highlights include Battle Mod toggles, using your own channel's emotes for in-game events, and an exciting, brand new battle mode! Read the full patch notes below!

[hr][/hr]

[*] [b]Slay the Streamer mode has been added![/b]

[i]Slay The Streamer is a new mode where chat bands together to defeat a super-powerful, gigantic version of the streamer's character. In the next update, I'm going to add more options to customize aspects of this battle mode. I'd like to continue adding unique features to this one over time.[/i]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] fixed a bug where 0 maps could be selected in the Battle Mode edit menu
[*] fixed an emote-related crash
[*] fixed some weapon skins not displaying properly in the Gold Shop
[*] fixed the timer sound not stopping in the Gold Shop
[*] fixed Venomous Blood upgrade crash
[*] fixed custom heal chat command not being saved/set
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] added Battle Mod toggles to the Battle Mode edit menu -- you can now customize which Battle Mods appear in your matches!
[*] added a little notification when you've successfully saved a Battle Mode
[*] clicking on a leaderboard entry now shouts that user out in chat
[*] added Reset to Default buttons in the Battle Mode edit menu
[*] spiffied up a lot of existing post-round stuff (some of that is invisible in Chroma Key mode)
[*] added Raffle post-round module (type an emote for a chance to win gold)
[*] added unique icons to more Upgrades
[/list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]
[list]
[*] made Crossbow more accurate
[*] reduced Crossbow attack cooldown by .5 sec
[*] increased Crossbow's range slightly (32 pixels)

[i]The Crossbow had been over-nerfed and wasn't really an effective weapon any longer, so it's been given a measured improvement and I feel it's in a much better place now. The way hitbox tracking and knockback works on the Crossbow has also been adjusted and feels more accurate and impactful, while not overshadowing the melee weapon's effectiveness.[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Maps[/h1]
[list]
[*] made a change to level generation filling 'pot-holes,' which should improve the overall fluidity of movement
[/list]

[h1]Cosmetics[/h1]
[list]
[*] added an 'Auto-Emote' option, which translates chat messages into in-game emotes, if they are owned (this can be disabled in the Settings menu under Display options)
[*] added Crackhead skin (5,000g)
[/list]

[h1]Chat Commands[/h1]
[list]
[*] added the ability to select custom emotes from your own channel for specific events in the Twitch settings menu
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] added a little trail to attacking units to help follow them visually as they attack
[*] Jabberjinx/Babblebless percentages now scale based on how many players are involved in the current battle (more players = lower percent blessing/curse)
[/list]

notes.title: Chat Champions closed beta update -- b3
notes.content:
Big update this time around, featuring the all-new UPGRADE system as well as the debut of WEAPON SKINS! The menu UI has also been completely re-hauled with a more sophisticated interface allowing for easier navigation and more customization options than ever before. In addition, there is now a CUSTOM GAME MODE setting, where you can quickly select between a pre-made set of rules, or make and save your own!

Beta testers, your save files and statistics have been reset once again!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] fixed Top Performance mid-round module being black instead of the player's name color
[*] fixed a bug with !raising the Gold Shop's Community Goal
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] new menu system with many more customization options added
[*] custom game modes added
[*] updated Leaderboards UI to match new menu system
[*] updated the post-round and Battle Mod UI
[/list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Introducing, UPGRADES![/b]

Between each round, players now have the option to select one of three random upgrades to apply for the remainder of the match! All players have to do is type 1, 2, or 3 in chat to select an upgrade.

Upgrades stack with each other as well as Battle Modifications and blessings/curses. The Upgrades feature can be toggled from the Settings menu, where individual Upgrades can be toggled as well. Currently, there are 34 unique Upgrades, with more planned for the future. Players can check which Upgrades they have selected by using the !myupgrades/!upgrades commands.
[/list]

[h1]Maps[/h1]
[list]
[h2]Arena[/h2]
[*] added 2 more layouts and made some minor adjustments to existing ones
[/list]

[h1]Battle Mods[/h1]
[list]
[*] added Prize Fight mod (last player standing receives a random cosmetic drop), which is only available in the Free-For-All battle mode
[*] reduced healing over time in Sudden Death
[/list]

[h1]Economy[/h1]
[list]
[*] adjusted the drop rates again -- each item in the drop pool is randomly removed based on rarity (2% chance legendary included in possible drop, 8% chance ultra rare, 35% chance rare, 75% chance uncommon, 100% chance common)
[*] adjusted the prices & rarities of player skins
[/list]

[h1]Cosmetics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Weapon skins have been added to the game! Currently, each weapon has 5 unique skins (40 in total) with more coming soon. Weapon skins may also be acquired from a random item drop. 

A player's weapon skin inventory can be viewed in chat by typing !weapons, and can be equipped by typing the weapon's name (e.g. !dagger) followed by the weapon skin's ID. (e.g. !dagger 3) Weapon skins have no affect on in-game attributes and are purely cosmetic.

[*] added particle effects to Snoozer and Cupid player skins
[*] added Cyclops and Nugget player skins (bringing us up to 20 skins in total)
[/list]

[h1]Chat Commands[/h1]
[list]
[*] instead of displaying numbers for each item, the !inventory now displays the amount of items owned for each type (!hats, !skins, !emotes, !weapons) along with the corresponding chat commands to access more detailed inventory displays. This change was made to hopefully consolidate and clean up inventory messages.
[*] !items & !inv now function the same as !inventory
[/list]

[h1]Known Bugs/Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] there is a slight visual hitch when switching between menus
[*] in-game pause-menu does not match new UI
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] player names/avatars have been moved below the health bar to make weapon skins more visible
[*] Combat Staff has been renamed to Staff for brevity's sake
[*] War Hammer has been renamed to Hammer for brevity's sake
[*] War Axe has been renamed to Axe for brevity's sake
[*] fire now deals 2 damage per tick (up from 1)
[/list]

notes.title: Chat Champions closed beta update -- b2.53
notes.content:
Welcome to the next era of Chat Champions -- the dawn of patch notes! Below are the (mostly complete unless I forgot something or deemed it too minor to write down which is highly likely) patch notes for version b2.53.

Everyone's save files, in-game statistics, and Steam achievements/statistics have been reset once again.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] added more checks to catch missed !join commands
[*] fixed chat commands/random chat messages counting as Battle Mod votes
[*] fixed random item drops giving players duplicate items
[*] fixed players errantly being granted Sub rewards
[*] when a player !raises more gold than is required for the Gold Shop Community Goals, the Twitch confirmation message now displays the correct amount donated instead of 0 or a negative number
[*] fixed the Gold Shop's Community Goal title not updating once a goal was completed
[/list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]
[list]
[*] players' movement speed may now be affected by which weapon they are holding
[*] War Hammer base movement speed and maximum movement speed reduced (1 > .5 and 3 > 2, respectively)
[*] War Axe base movement speed and maximum movement speed reduced (1 > .85 and 3 > 2.75, respectively)
[/list]

[h1]Maps[/h1]

[h3]New map added -- Arena[/h3]
[i]The Arena randomly chooses a smaller, symmetrical, pre-made layout to host the battle on. Currently, there are 10 layouts, with more coming.[/i]

[h3]Caverns[/h3]
[list]
[*] added bats
[/list]

[h1]Economy[/h1]
[list]
[*] lowered the drop rates for more rare items
[*] lowered participation gold reward (100g > 50g)
[*] adjusted how level-up gold reward is given (from a flat 500g to 100g * level)
[*] increased cost of Gold Shop Community Goals (2,500g > 5,000g)
[/list]

[h1]Cosmetics[/h1]
[list]
[*] added Snoozer skin (10,000g)
[*] added Cupid skin (10,000g)
[*] !emotes now pop up as in-game messages
[/list]

[h1]Battle Mods[/h1]
[list]
[*] Blood Bounty mod has been changed (double XP for kills > earn increasing XP for kills) and renamed to Battle Scars
[*] added (new) Blood Bounty mod (earn increasing gold for kills)
[*] added Sudden Death mod (start at 1 HP and gain health over time)
[*] added Opposite Day mod (!heal makes you explode)
[*] added Hurlatron mod (gravity shifts every 5 seconds)
[*] added Haymakers mod (War Hammers and War Axes only)
[/list]

[h1]Chat Commands[/h1]
[list]
[*] added !skins, !hats, and !emotes commands which return player's inventories for those specific items
[*] if a player's skin, hat, or emote inventory equals or exceeds 10 items, that list will be truncated into individual inventory return commands (!skins, !hats, !emotes)
[*] !attack [target] now does the same as !target [target]
[/list]

[h1]Options[/h1]
[list]
[*] added toggle for all Twitch messages sent on the game's behalf
[*] added toggle for MVP Announcement in Twitch chat
[*] added toggle for random item drop notifications in chat
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] added a cooldown to the Gold Shop Community Goal completion to prevent goals from being completed twice accidentally
[*] added 'All's Fair In Love' achievement (players have healed one another 1,000 times)
